title: 668. Maximum Length of Pair Chain

examples.explanation: [1,2] then [3,4] is valid, but [1,2] then [2,3] is not since 2 is not less than 2.

hints: Sort all pairs by their second entry ascending.
Greedily take each pair whose first entry exceeds the last taken second entry.
Earliest finishers leave the most room, so this greedy pass is optimal.
